package_findings: The six selected collector, auditor, monitor and recovery scripts form a complete standard-library import graph; frozen financial reports are not needed for these runtime paths.
Final image uses an immutable upstream Python index digest, nonroot UID/GID, explicit source COPY list, per-script SHA manifest, and a recorded source-revision label.

Standalone Compose has no source bind mounts or published ports, one writable evidence mount, disabled application network, network_mode none, read-only root, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges.
Prior parent-directory build-context inclusion concern was addressed with explicit descendant exclusions, an isolated context-audit target, and a CI sentinel/export exact-nine-file check.
CI distinguishes a locally built content-addressed image ID from a registry manifest digest; registry publication remains false.

CI separately checks actual startup health, source checksums, image identity, Python version, user, network mode, root read-only state, source mount absence and zero captures before recording success.
